businessHome.title: Business home
businessHome.subtitle: What a business sees on the home of its panel (cestoshop.com/business). Separate from the shop's Home Sections. Changes show within a few minutes.
businessHome.resetMessage: This discards every edit on all five tabs, promotions and announcements included, and restores the shipped copy. It cannot be undone.
businessHome.heading: Heading
businessHome.linkHint: A panel page such as /business/catalogue or /business/products/…, a shop page (/products/…), or a web address (https://…).
businessHome.toneHint: The background when there is no image.
businessHome.introHint: The first of the home's own banners, shown while the team has none of its own (with the catalogue and the shops after it). New products' photos fan out beside it unless you add an image.
businessHome.introImageHint: Shown on tablets and computers. Leave it empty for the shop illustration.
businessHome.promotionsHint: The bento under the banners: the first one is the big tile and the rest fit around it, so any number from 1 to 8 fills whole rows. Only the ones shown to businesses appear, in this order.
businessHome.logisticsHint: The home's map story: the title and text open it, and each point below is one step, told in this order as the map flies over Spain. A point's icon picks where it goes: Shop → the partner shops, Truck or Map pin → the road, Receipt or Euro → the whole network, any other → the depot. Write only what is true today — delivery days, areas, cut-off times.
businessHome.imageWideHint: A wide strip, 4:1 — e.g. 1600 × 400. Shown on screens 768 px and wider; keep what matters away from the edges.
businessHome.imagePhoneHint: 16:9 — e.g. 800 × 450. Shown on phones and small tablets; the computer image is used when this is empty.
businessHome.announcementsHint: "News from Cesto" beside the banners: dated ones first, soonest first, each leaving the home the day after its date; undated ones stay until you switch them off. A business sees which it has not opened yet, and opens each full screen.
businessHome.dateHint: The day it is about. Optional.
businessHome.bannersHint: The banner ads at the top of the home: only your images, shown exactly as you upload them — put any words, prices or buttons in the image itself. One at a time, sliding along by themselves (a business can swipe them too); a tap opens the link. Upload a wide image for computers and, if you like, one for phones. Shown in this order, up to 6. With none, the home has no banner.

panel.costInvalid: Enter a buying price of 0 or more
panel.costFailed: Could not save the buying price

orderCreate.clearConfirm: Remove every item from this order? This cannot be undone.
orderCreate.restoredBodyOne: 1 product from before the page reloaded.
orderCreate.restoredBodyMany: {{count}} products from before the page reloaded.
orderCreate.savedDraftBody: No stock is held yet — confirming the draft reserves it.
orderCreate.costHint: What we pay for one. Saved with the order, it becomes the product's buying price too. Only admins see it.
orderCreate.costsNotSaved: The order was saved, but its buying prices were not

hg.title: Home Grocery order
hg.hintDue: Part of their Home Grocery. Their next order is due {{date}}; the day and time below come from their delivery information.
hg.hint: Part of their Home Grocery. The day and time below come from their delivery information.
hg.off: An ordinary order: not part of their Home Grocery and with no delivery day.

blocker.seller_not_configured: Your company's fiscal details are missing — legal name, CIF/NIF and address. Fill them in under Settings → Invoicing, or right here on the document.
blocker.unreviewed_vat_one: 1 product has an unreviewed IVA rate. Check the rate on its line before issuing.
blocker.unreviewed_vat_other: {{count}} products have an unreviewed IVA rate. Check the rate on each line before issuing.
blocker.buyer_tax_id_missing: The customer has no CIF/NIF. A full factura needs one — you can type it on the document.
blocker.order_draft: The order is waiting on stock. It can be quoted, but not invoiced until it is confirmed.
blocker.already_invoiced: This order already has an issued factura. A correction goes out as a credit note.

invoices.facturaBlocked: This order cannot be invoiced yet
invoices.facturaBlockedWhy: Resolve the points below, or switch this draft to an albarán.
invoices.fillItHere: Fill in what is missing on this document and then issue it — nothing else has to change first.
invoices.willBeFactura: Ready to issue as a full invoice
invoices.willBeAlbaran: This will be issued as an albarán
invoices.albaranWhy: An albarán is not a fiscal document. Resolve the points below to issue a real invoice instead.
invoices.issuedBody: Number {{n}} assigned. It can no longer be changed.
invoices.confirmAlbaranNote: This goes out as an ALBARÁN, which is not valid as an invoice for IVA purposes. It says so on the document.
invoices.confirmIssueBody: A number is assigned now and the document is frozen. It cannot be edited or deleted afterwards — a correction has to go out as a credit note.
invoices.confirmIssueLead: This is a one-way step. Three things happen the moment you confirm:
invoices.consequenceNumber: A number is assigned from the {{s}} series. It is used up even if you later decide the document was wrong.
invoices.consequenceFrozen: The document itself cannot be edited or deleted. A correction goes out as a credit note.
invoices.consequenceOrder: The order is closed. Its items and delivery fee can no longer be changed — by you, by the shop, or by the customer.
invoices.confirmDeleteBody: Nothing has been issued, so no number is used up. You can create a new draft from the order.
invoices.frozen: Issued documents cannot be changed. Corrections go out as a credit note.

doc.unreviewedVatNotice: Tipo de IVA no revisado para este producto.
doc.albaranNotice: Confirma la entrega. No es una factura ni una solicitud de pago.

invoices.albaranNotice: An albarán confirms delivery. It is not an invoice and not a request for payment.
invoices.latestAlbaran: The most recent albarán issued for this order
invoices.lastLine: A document needs at least one line
invoices.restoredBody: From before the page reloaded. Save them, or press Discard changes to drop them.
invoices.restoreStaleTitle: Your unsaved changes were not kept
invoices.restoreStaleBody: This document changed after you left it. Start again from what it holds now.
invoices.saveBeforeIssue: Save your changes first: the PDF and the issued document use the saved version.
invoices.hideKeepOne: A document needs at least one line
invoices.hiddenBody: Not printed and not counted in the totals. The order itself does not change.
invoices.hiddenIssuedBody: Hidden when it was issued: not on the PDF and not in its totals.
invoices.hideFailed: Could not change the lines shown
invoices.confirmHiddenNote: {{n}} hidden line(s) will be left off it and out of its total.
invoices.detached: This draft no longer follows its order. Changes to the order will not appear here.

invoicingSettings.title: Invoicing
invoicingSettings.subtitle: Who the invoices are issued by
invoicingSettings.readyBody: A client also needs a CIF/NIF on their record, and every product on the order needs a reviewed IVA rate.
invoicingSettings.notReadyBody: Legal name, CIF/NIF and address are all required before a document can be a fiscal invoice.
invoicingSettings.readOnly: Only a super admin can change these.
invoicingSettings.seriesHint: Uppercase letters only. A prefix cannot be changed once a document has been issued under it — that would split one legal series across two names.

customerOrders.title: Orders
customerOrders.emptyFiltered: Try a different search or clear the filters.
customerOrders.emptyNone: This customer has not ordered yet.

users.subtitle: Everyone with an account — customers, vendors, riders and staff
users.title: Users

staff.addBody: They sign in with this email and a generated password you hand over once.
staff.name: Name
staff.emailLocked: This is their sign-in identity and cannot be changed later.

roleBlurb.super_admin: Everything, including staff accounts, invoicing settings and permanent deletes.
roleBlurb.lawyer: Only the document archive: facturas, albaranes and bills, to read and download.

staff.tempHint: Shown once. Hand it over now — they must change it at first sign-in.
staff.resetBody: A new temporary password is generated and every active session for this account is ended. They will have to sign in again and choose a new password.
staff.emptyBody: Add the people who need access to this panel.

b2bDirectory.search: Search by name, company or email…
b2bDirectory.approved: Approved. Business account created and credentials emailed.
b2bDirectory.approvedLinked: Approved. Existing customer upgraded to a business account.
b2bDirectory.emptyBody: Approved B2B leads and wholesale clients both appear here.
b2bDirectory.approvedPartner: Approved. Store created as a draft — the partner publishes it once they have added a delivery area.
b2bDirectory.openCount: {{count}} open above, pinned to this page

partners.search: Search by name, store or email…
partners.emptyBody: Shops applying to sell on Cesto appear here, and stay as partners once approved.

link.title: Add a partner
link.body: The person you choose manages the store from Cesto Shop — its products, its orders and its details.
link.emailHint: It is their login. An account with this email is used; otherwise one is made.
link.blocked: {{name}}'s account is blocked. Unblock it before giving it a store.
link.keepsPassword: They keep the password they use now — nothing about their sign-in changes.
link.getsPassword: They have no password of their own yet, so a temporary one is issued.
link.name: Their name
link.nameHint: No account has this email yet — one is made in this name, with a temporary password.
link.storeDraft: It starts as a draft, hidden from customers. You finish its details and publish it on its page.
link.noStores: Every store Cesto set up already has a partner. Create a new store instead — or, to move a store to somebody else, unlink its partner on the store’s page first.
link.inherits: They will manage everything already on this store.
link.emailIssued: Email them how to sign in, with their temporary password
link.emailKept: Email them that they now manage the store
link.handOver: The temporary password is shown here once, for you to hand over.
link.doneBody: They manage it from Cesto Shop: they sign in, then choose "Manage store".
link.keptDone: They sign in with the password they already use — it has not changed.
link.toldByEmail: We emailed {{email}} to say they now manage the store.
link.notTold: No email went out, so let them know yourself.
link.draftNote: {{store}} is a draft, hidden from customers. Finish its details and publish it on its page when it is ready.

resend.title: New login for {{name}}?
resend.body: This issues a NEW temporary password — the one they have cannot be read back. It stops working the moment you confirm, and they are signed out everywhere, in the middle of whatever they were doing in their store. The email tells them how to reach their store.
resend.issuedHint: Shown once. Their previous password no longer works. They choose their own when they sign in.
resend.sentBody: Their previous password no longer works.

panel.title: Who manages this store
panel.subtitle: A partner signs in to Cesto Shop and manages the store from "Manage store": its products, its orders and its details.
panel.unknown: Who manages this store is shown once the server is updated.
panel.emptyBody: Give it to somebody — a customer who already has an account, or a new one — and they become its partner.
panel.deleted: This store is deleted. Restore it before giving it a partner.
panel.scheduled: This store is scheduled for deletion. Cancel the deletion before giving it a partner.
panel.accessOwn: Signs in with their own password
panel.accessTemp: Has not signed in yet (temporary password)
panel.accessNone: No password yet — send them a login
panel.unlinkHint: To give this store to somebody else, unlink its partner first.
panel.unlinkBody: {{names}} will no longer be able to manage {{store}}. Their account stays and they can still shop; the store keeps its products and orders. You can give the store to somebody again afterwards.
panel.unlinkedBody: {{store}} has no partner now. Their account, its products and its orders all stay.

quotations.search: Search by product, name or company…
quotations.emptyBody: Requests from a product page appear here, with the product and quantity asked for.

errors.refreshFailedBody: What you are looking at may be out of date.

homeGrocery.search: Search by name, phone, email or postcode…
homeGrocery.emptyBody: Requests from the Home Grocery form on the website appear here, and stay as subscribers once approved.
homeGrocery.openCount: {{count}} requests waiting above, pinned to this page
homeGrocery.approvedLinked: Approved — {{name}} is a Home Grocery subscriber.
homeGrocery.approvedLinkedBody: Their account was linked as it is. They have been notified.
homeGrocery.approvedCreatedBody: Their login is on its way by email.
homeGrocery.approvedCreatedNoMail: The login email did not go out. Resend the credentials from their customer page.
homeGrocery.rejectedTold: The household has been told why.
homeGrocery.rejectedUntold: No notification could reach them — let them know by phone.

modal.approveSubtitle: {{name}} becomes a Home Grocery subscriber. Orders you build for them land in the Home Grocery book.
modal.rejectSubtitle: {{name}} will be told, with your reason, word for word.
modal.blocked: This account is blocked. Unblock it before approving.
modal.linkBody: Nothing about the account changes — not the name, not the password. They get a notification and an email saying they are approved.
modal.openBody: No account matches this request. One is created and the login emailed to the address below — check it carefully.
modal.name: Name
modal.phoneHint: Leave blank if another account already uses this number.
modal.addressWhyLinked: Their account has no address yet, and an order cannot be built without one.
modal.addressWhyNew: Needed to open the account — prefilled from the form. The form never asked for the province.
modal.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. We do not deliver to your postcode yet — we will let you know as soon as we do.
modal.reachBoth: They will see it in their notifications and get it by email.
modal.reachInApp: They will see it in their notifications.
modal.reachEmail: They have no account — the reason goes by email only.
modal.reachNone: No account and no email — call them on {{phone}} to tell them.

close.hint: Close without replying — a duplicate or a test
close.title: Close this request without replying?
close.body: {{name}}'s request leaves the queue and nothing is sent to them. Use it for a duplicate or a test — it stays in All requests.

hgPlan.loadFailed: This household could not be loaded.
hgPlan.pausedBanner: Paused since {{date}}. Nothing is planned until the plan is resumed.
hgPlan.droppedBanner: Left out of the planned delivery, off sale: {{names}}. Take them off the list or put them back on sale.
hgPlan.notSubscriberBody: Only an approved household is a Home Grocery customer. Approve their request first.

next.title: Next delivery
next.overdue: The day has passed and stock is not confirmed
next.paused: Nothing planned while the plan is paused.

explain.draft: A draft: it holds no stock and still follows the household’s list — their changes reach it until you confirm stock on the order. Confirming is when we start preparing it.
explain.pending: Stock confirmed. Its list is final; changes to the plan apply from the next delivery.
explain.confirmed: Confirmed. Its list is final; changes to the plan apply from the next delivery.
explain.on_the_way: On its way to the household.

next.feePending: delivery fee not set yet — set it on the order after confirming stock

confirm.pauseBody: A planned delivery that is still a draft is withdrawn; one already confirmed still goes ahead. Nothing new is planned until you resume it.
confirm.skipBody: The delivery for {{date}} is cancelled as skipped, and the next one is planned one interval later.
confirm.endBody: The household stops receiving deliveries and its planned one is withdrawn. They stay a Home Grocery subscriber and can start a new plan.
confirm.pauseReminders: They get no reminders until you resume it. Orders under way go ahead, and orders can still be placed.
confirm.skipDraftBody: The delivery the plan made for {{date}} is cancelled as skipped.
confirm.endOrders: Their delivery settings and reminders stop. Orders already placed stay as they are. They stay a Home Grocery subscriber and can start a new plan.

done.pausedGoingAhead: The delivery already confirmed still goes ahead.
done.pausedBody: Nothing is planned until it is resumed.
done.skipped: Delivery skipped. The next one has been planned.
done.endedBody: Its planned delivery was withdrawn. Past deliveries stay in their orders.
done.resumed: Plan resumed. The next delivery has been planned.
done.savedUpcoming: Saved. The planned delivery follows it.
done.savedNext: The delivery already confirmed keeps its list; this applies from the next one.
done.createdBody: The first delivery is planned for {{date}}.
done.pausedReminders: No reminders until it is resumed. Orders under way go ahead.
done.endedOrders: Orders already placed stay as they are.
done.resumedReminders: Plan resumed. Reminders are back on.
done.createdOrders: Create their first order whenever they are ready.

list.title: List ({{count}})
list.reachesUpcoming: Saving changes the planned delivery for {{date}} too.
list.reachesNext: The delivery for {{date}} is confirmed and keeps its list; this applies from the next one.
list.alreadyIn: Already on the list — one more added.
list.empty: Nothing on the list yet. Add the products this household buys every time.
list.offSale: Off sale — left out of deliveries
list.estTotal: Estimated, at today’s prices for this household

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.dayHint: Suggested as the day of each order; any order can have another.
schedule.noAddress: This customer has no address. Add one on their customer page first.
schedule.notify: Remind them when an order is due
schedule.notifyHint: A notification a few days before their next order is due, by their frequency.

household.title: Household
household.business: A business account: its deliveries are priced at wholesale and go to the Wholesale book.

setup.listHint: What they want every time. Each delivery is made from it, and they can change it from the website.
setup.settingsHint: How often, when and where they like it. Each order suggests these, and they are reminded when one is due.

upcoming.title: Home Grocery orders coming up
upcoming.empty: No Home Grocery orders in the next {{count}} days.

hgPlan.pausedReminders: Paused since {{date}}: no reminders until it is resumed. Orders can still be placed.
hgPlan.dueBody: By how often they shop it would be for {{date}}, and nothing is under way.

open.title: Orders under way ({{count}})
open.pastDay: Its day has passed — move it or deliver it
open.feePending: delivery fee not set yet — set it on the order

hgSlot.changeBody: Their order page shows the new day and time. It can move until preparing starts.

stores.repsWarning_one: {{count}} sales rep sells from this shop. Switched off or suspended, its products leave their catalogue — and with no other shop they cannot build orders until you assign one.
stores.repsWarning_other: {{count}} sales reps sell from this shop. Switched off or suspended, its products leave their catalogues — and a rep with no other shop cannot build orders until you assign one.
stores.subtitle: Partner shops sold on Cesto. Manage their branding, hours, and products.
stores.emptyBody: Add your first partner shop to start associating products with a storefront.

bill.title: Bill
bill.pendingNote: The delivery fee is added once it is set.

documents.title: Document archive
documents.subtitle: Every factura, albarán and bill, to read or download.

empty.invoiceBody: A factura appears here as soon as it is issued.
empty.albaranBody: An albarán appears here as soon as it is issued.
empty.billBody: A bill appears here for every order placed.
empty.filteredBody: Try other dates or another search.

documents.loadFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.

bulk.title: Documents to download: {{count}}
bulk.body: They will be saved together as one ZIP file.
bulk.keepOpen: Keep this tab open while it works. Each document takes a moment to prepare.
bulk.doneParts: It was large, so it came as {{parts}} ZIP files.
bulk.skipped: These could not be made and are not in the ZIP:

detail.notFound: This document is not in the archive
detail.notFoundBody: It may be a draft, or the link may be wrong.
detail.billNote: Bills have no number and are not stored: this one shows the order as it stands today.

viewer.failedBody: Check your connection and try again.

documents.pdfNotSavedBody: The document is issued. Its PDF will be saved the next time it is opened in Documents.

password.title: Change your password
password.body: Every other place you are signed in is signed out when it changes.
password.forcedBody: You signed in with a password somebody else gave you. Pick one only you know before you continue.
password.hint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords don't match.
password.same: Choose a password different from the current one.
password.failed: Your password couldn't be changed. Try again.
password.doneBody: Other places where you were signed in have been signed out.
